sentence: This project tests how a nanogenerator can deliver electrical stimulation to speed up the healing of chronic wounds in several wound models.
This project studies how different strains of a gut bacterium in infants affect child growth, infections and the development of the gut microbiome.
This project uses a technology that reads fragments of DNA in the blood to track how a prostate cancer tumor changes during treatment.
This project tries to grow a fungal infection in cell culture and to understand its genetic structure.
This project tries to find out which chemical properties let small molecules get into and build up inside drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii cells.
This project develops imaging tools that use ultrasound to study how blood vessel changes soften the cervix during pregnancy.
This project builds an imaging method that measures blood flow and oxygen levels in the retina of rats with oxygen-induced retinopathy.
This project tests whether a skin patch treatment for peanut allergy is safe and well tolerated in children and adults.
This project studies how the proteins that carry out mismatch repair work in yeast.
This project tests how errors in public databases affect bioinformatics pipelines and builds ways to guard against them.
This project offers technology and business services to pediatric device innovators to help their devices move toward clinical implementation.
This project offers a method that uses mass spectrometry to show the structure of proteins and nucleic acid in solution.
This project builds a way to follow single cancer cells as they migrate in living bodies, using laser particles that give an optical barcode.
This project develops ways to prepare and separate brain samples so their proteins and metabolites can be measured by mass spectrometry.
This project builds brain imaging tools that measure how methylphenidate changes brain activity and brain chemistry in children and adolescents.
This project builds machine learning models that use spatial genomic data to describe cell types and how they are arranged and interact in tissues.
This project uses CRISPR to find metabolic weak spots linked to particular mutations in lung cancer.
This project studies how a risk gene type and immunotherapy affect amyloid buildup in Alzheimer's disease, and tests diet and exercise to reduce it.
This project studies the nigrotegmental circuit in a mouse model of epilepsy to see how it controls seizures.
This project tests whether faulty immune cells caused by mitochondrial defects lead to lasting brain damage after infections in mitochondrial disease.
